## Workshop — Trace Explorer
Click a link below to open a pre-built query in Explore. Click any **Trace ID** in the results to open the full waterfall.

### All transfer requests

All `POST /transfers/prepare` traces from the last hour.  
Sort by **Duration** to find the outlier.

**[Open in Explore →](/explore?orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22P214B5B846CF3925F%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22traceql%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%7B%20resource.service.name%20%3D%20%5C%22transfer-service%5C%22%20%26%26%20name%20%3D%20%5C%22POST%20%2Ftransfers%2Fprepare%5C%22%20%7D%22%2C%22limit%22%3A50%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-1h%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D)**

### Slow traces only  (> 2 s)

Traces that exceeded the expected latency threshold.  
Click a Trace ID and examine the **waterfall**.

**[Open in Explore →](/explore?orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22P214B5B846CF3925F%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22traceql%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%7B%20resource.service.name%20%3D%20%5C%22transfer-service%5C%22%20%26%26%20name%20%3D%20%5C%22POST%20%2Ftransfers%2Fprepare%5C%22%20%26%26%20duration%20%3E%202s%20%7D%22%2C%22limit%22%3A20%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-1h%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D)**

### TraceQL reference

Use these in Explore → TraceQL tab:

```
{ resource.service.name = "transfer-service"
  && name = "POST /transfers/prepare" }
```
```
{ resource.service.name = "transfer-service"
  && name = "POST /transfers/prepare"
  && duration > 2s }
```

### How to read the waterfall

1. Open a slow trace from the link above
2. Look at which span takes the most time
3. Expand the child spans — are they **sequential** or **overlapping**?
4. Check the **Attributes** tab on each span

The bug is visible in the **timing**, not in the attribute values.
